name: Being Falsely Accused
overview: Scripture acknowledges the pain and injustice of being falsely accused, as seen in the psalmist's lament over deceitful and wicked tongues that speak lies against the righteous. The wise are cautioned to avoid strife without cause, emphasizing integrity in speech and action. God assures His servants that no weapon or false accusation formed against them will ultimately succeed, and that justice will prevail, with the wicked facing punishment while the just find deliverance through knowledge and the Lord's righteousness.
